criteria: Discussed on Reddit, so acquisition and ORM both apply
Second batch: founder and creator led course brands, smaller than the first ten and far more argued about online, so reputation work is the entry point

Third batch: agencies, not brands. Reddit, ORM and growth shops that already sell Reddit or reputation work but have no Reddit network of their own. They buy supply from GrowwDaddy and keep their own client relationship, so the pitch is white label partnership, not enrolments.
meta.email_sourcing: Every address was read off the company's own contact page or rendered site on 2026-09-06 — none pattern-guessed. Re-verify with a validator before sending. Agency batch added 2026-09-08: every address was scraped from the agency's own contact, about or home page on that date, Cloudflare obfuscated addresses decoded from the page source. None pattern-guessed. Re-verify with a validator before sending.
meta.known_gap: These are company inboxes, not decision makers. Pair each with the Head of Marketing / Brand / Growth on LinkedIn; at Scaler, upGrad and TalentSprint (now Accenture) the shared inbox alone will rarely reach anyone with budget. In the creator led batch the founder is the brand, so the shared inbox is more likely to reach someone with authority, but three addresses (GrowthSchool, Booming Bulls, Rachana Ranade) came off indexed pages that block direct reads. Verify those with a validator first. In the agency batch the shared inbox is usually the right door because most are small and founder run, but at Sociallyin, Single Grain, Siege Media, Directive, Schbang and WATConsult pair the inbox with a partnerships or new business contact on LinkedIn. Status Labs publishes no general inbox at all, only a form and a press address, so treat that one as needing a named contact first.
before_you_send: SPF, DKIM and DMARC on the sending domain
Send from a subdomain (mail.growwdaddy.com), never the root domain that runs the site's own mail
10-15 sends a day, spread out, never a blast
Plain text, no tracking pixel, no attachment, one link at most
Keep the opt-out line — Interview Kickstart is US (CAN-SPAM), upGrad and TalentSprint handle EU learners (GDPR)
meta.email_copy: Approved edtech copy lives in outreach/emails.txt. The agency batch uses a partnership variant of the same structure, held inline in each record here.
